kpis.name: Schedule Variance (SV)
kpis.description: Difference between earned value and planned value, expressed as a percentage of planned value.

kpis.name: Cost Variance (CV)
kpis.description: Difference between earned value and actual cost.

kpis.name: Schedule Performance Index (SPI)
kpis.description: Efficiency of time performance: earned value over planned value.

kpis.name: Cost Performance Index (CPI)
kpis.description: Efficiency of cost performance: earned value over actual cost.

kpis.name: Project RAG status
kpis.description: Composite red/amber/green status across schedule, cost, scope, risk and HSE.
kpis.formula: Composite of schedule, cost, scope, risk and HSE

kpis.name: Percent surfacing complete
kpis.description: Proportion of the surface course complete against the total area.
kpis.formula: surfacing area complete / total surfacing area * 100

kpis.name: Lane-miles traffic management compliant
kpis.description: Lane-miles of TM installed compliantly against the total in operation.
kpis.formula: TM compliant lane-miles / total TM lane-miles * 100

kpis.name: Embodied carbon intensity
kpis.description: Embodied and construction carbon per lane-kilometre against the envelope.

kpis.name: Ecology compensation ratio
kpis.description: Habitat created or enhanced against habitat lost.
kpis.formula: habitat units created / habitat units lost

kpis.name: Lost Time Injury Rate (LTIR)
kpis.description: Lost-time injuries per 100,000 hours worked.

kpis.name: Near-miss reporting frequency
kpis.description: Number of near misses reported, tracked to encourage reporting.

kpis.name: Rework rate
kpis.description: Rework hours as a percentage of construction hours.

kpis.name: Percent WBS tasks with actuals
kpis.description: Proportion of live WBS tasks that have recorded actuals.

kpis.name: Milestone achievement rate
kpis.description: Proportion of milestones achieved on or before their due date.
kpis.formula: milestones achieved on time / total milestones * 100

kpis.name: Utilities diversion hit-rate
kpis.description: Proportion of utility diversions delivered to programme.

kpis.name: Snagging closure rate
kpis.description: Proportion of snagging items closed by the handover target.

kpis.name: Planning / DCO consent status
kpis.description: Status of the planning/DCO consent milestone against programme.

kpis.name: Weather disruption days
kpis.description: Construction days lost to weather against the allowance.

kpis.name: Community complaints per week
kpis.description: Number of community complaints logged per week.

kpis.name: First-time yield (pavement tests)
kpis.description: Proportion of pavement tests passing first time.
